Chapter 6693: Together?

Chapter 6693: Together?

The duo froze momentarily despite their recent improvement. Desolate Ancestor was a brilliant founder and nearly a primordial immortal.

Bao Pu had no confidence, and the same was true for the ghost despite having primordial power. After all, he didn’t cultivate the redemption ground himself.

Both stared at Weizhen, thinking about his three corpses and Supreme Heaven’s vitality and life. That immortal formation could help fuel the corpses.

That would give them five immortals - a decent chance of winning against Desolate Ancetor.

However, Weizhen acted as if he didn’t notice their stare.

“Brother Weizhen, we should team up.” Bao Pu impatiently said.

“I am not involved in this feud, nor is Supreme Heaven.” Weizhen unexpectedly shook his head.

“What?!” Spectators found this surprising.

“Brother, we are on the same side, sharing honor and disgrace.” The ghost immediately said.

For all of them, the existence of Desolate Ancestor and Life and Death Heaven was a major threat.

“No, the agreement ends here. We only promised to kill the primordials.” Weizhen said.

Initially, the two primordial immortals pulled Bao Pu and the ghost into attacking Life and Death Heaven. Supreme Heaven was involved as well.

However, Weizhen secretly formed a pact with Bao Pu and the ghost to put an end to the primordial immortals. Bao Pu and the ghost agreed, promising to owe Supreme Heaven a favor and repay it once summoned.

“Brother, this is our common enemy, our original intent in joining forces!” The ghost became anxious.

“No, we only planned to kill the primordial immortals. Attacking Life and Death Heaven was a separate agreement between me and the primordial immortals.” Weizhen said.

Upon reflection, Weizhen was right.

“Brother, if anything happens to us, you will be next.” Bao Pu’s expression darkened.

“Each matter has its course, Brother, now is your turn to take the stage, not ours.” Weizhen refused and retreated with the three corpses.

This confused the duo and everyone else. They had a force similar to five immortals - this should be enough to kill Desolate Ancestor and stop the lord’s ascension.

“Brother, if you plan to reap the benefits without getting involved, it won’t go as you wish.” Bao Pu looked annoyed, feeling as if he had been set up.

The ghost had a moment of realization as well. The crowd followed suit.

Did Weizhen just want to watch and wait for the right moment to deliver a fatal blow to either party? He and Supreme Heaven would be the last ones standing then.

“This is quite a bold game, can Weizhen keep it under control?” An overlord murmured.

Judging from the current situation, things were more or less playing in his favor. He could get rid of all the immortals.

“Brother, you are overthinking it. It is merely the end of our agreement, nothing more.” Weizhen shook his head.

“All of you can come together.” Desolate Ancestor had enough of this.

“Ancestor, this firefly dares not to compete against your brilliance.” Weizhen bowed and exited the field.

“You two then.” Desolate Ancestor challenged Bao Pu and the ghost.

They staggered backward, not confident in the slightest.

“Fellow Daoist, I doubt they can withstand a few slashes. What meaning is there in drawing your blade against them?” A melodious and rhythmic voice echoed.

It startled everyone while a portal opened. Primordial particles drifted out and cascaded into three thousand worlds.

Beyond the portal was a colossal primordial tree. Three Immortals was only one of its many fruits.

“Who is this?” The crowd didn’t recognize this audacious person.
